resources.string: Use the same platform, Supabase project and chatbot as the web app so your conversations sync. These values are public; never enter private keys.

Checks about every 30 minutes while you have a network connection. Not real time. Notifications never show email content and never approve anything.
Sign out? Saved conversations and pending requests on this device will be removed. Your conversations stay on the server.
